tool_schemas.name: create_feishu_document
tool_schemas.description: Creates a new Feishu document of the requested doc_type (doc or docx) under the optional folder_token and returns the created document’s identifiers and basic metadata. If idempotency_key is provided, repeated calls with the same key return the same creation result instead of creating duplicates. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR when tenant_id/title/doc_type are missing or invalid (including tenant_id pattern mismatch or unsupported doc_type), UNAUTHORIZED/FORBIDDEN when the tenant connection is missing/disabled or the tenant lacks permission to create in the target folder, NOT_FOUND when folder_token does not exist or is not accessible, and CONFLICT when the idempotency_key is reused with different input parameters.

tenant_id.description: Tenant connection id (ULID) used to authenticate Feishu API calls.

folder_token.description: Optional Feishu Drive folder token to create the document under.

idempotency_key.description: Optional idempotency key to safely retry document creation without duplicates.

tool_schemas.name: get_feishu_document_info
tool_schemas.description: Fetches basic metadata for a Feishu document (such as title and type) and returns the document info; when refresh=true we re-fetch from Feishu and update any stored metadata snapshot. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR when tenant_id/document_id are missing or malformed, UNAUTHORIZED/FORBIDDEN when the tenant connection is invalid or does not have access to the document, and NOT_FOUND when the document_id does not exist or is not visible to the tenant.

tenant_id.description: Tenant connection id (ULID) used to authenticate Feishu API calls.

document_id.description: Feishu document id/token (doc/docx id) to fetch metadata for.

refresh.description: When true, forces a fresh fetch from Feishu and updates cached document metadata if stored.

tool_schemas.name: get_feishu_document_content
tool_schemas.description: Returns the document’s plain-text content (structure preserved without styling); when refresh=true we re-fetch from Feishu and update any stored content snapshot. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR when tenant_id/document_id are missing or malformed, UNAUTHORIZED/FORBIDDEN when the tenant connection is invalid or lacks permission to read the document, and NOT_FOUND when the document_id does not exist or is not accessible to the tenant.

tenant_id.description: Tenant connection id (ULID) used to authenticate Feishu API calls.

document_id.description: Feishu document id/token (doc/docx id) to fetch plain text content for.

refresh.description: When true, forces a fresh fetch from Feishu and updates cached content snapshot if stored.

tool_schemas.name: get_feishu_document_blocks
tool_schemas.description: Lists the document’s block hierarchy and returns blocks in pages of up to page_size (1–500), using page_token for continuation; when refresh=true we re-fetch from Feishu and update any stored block snapshot. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR when required fields are missing/invalid or when page_size/page_token are invalid, UNAUTHORIZED/FORBIDDEN when the tenant connection is invalid or lacks permission to read blocks, and NOT_FOUND when the document_id does not exist or is not accessible.

tenant_id.description: Tenant connection id (ULID) used to authenticate Feishu API calls.

document_id.description: Feishu document id/token (doc/docx id) to fetch blocks for.

page_size.description: Number of blocks to return per page when listing blocks.

page_token.description: Pagination token returned by a previous blocks request.

refresh.description: When true, forces a fresh fetch from Feishu and updates cached block snapshot if stored.

tool_schemas.name: get_feishu_block_content
tool_schemas.description: Returns the full content/structure for a specific block_id within the given document_id; when refresh=true we re-fetch from Feishu and update any stored block record. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR when tenant_id/document_id/block_id are missing or malformed, UNAUTHORIZED/FORBIDDEN when the tenant connection is invalid or lacks permission to read the document/block, and NOT_FOUND when the document or block does not exist or is not accessible under the tenant.

tenant_id.description: Tenant connection id (ULID) used to authenticate Feishu API calls.

document_id.description: Feishu document id/token (doc/docx id) that the block belongs to.

block_id.description: Feishu block id to retrieve detailed content/structure for.

refresh.description: When true, forces a fresh fetch from Feishu and updates cached block record if stored.

tool_schemas.name: search_feishu_documents
tool_schemas.description: Searches Feishu Drive for items matching query and returns a paged list of matching items (filtered by optional item_types and owner_user_id) with up to page_size results per page and a page_token for the next page when more results exist. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR when tenant_id/query are missing or invalid, when item_types contains unsupported values, or when page_size/page_token are invalid; raises UNAUTHORIZED/FORBIDDEN when the tenant connection is invalid or search is not permitted for the tenant; and may raise NOT_FOUND when an owner_user_id filter refers to a user that is not visible to the tenant.

tenant_id.description: Tenant connection id (ULID) used to authenticate Feishu API calls.

query.description: Keyword query to search across Feishu documents.

item_types.description: Optional filter for returned Drive item types.

owner_user_id.description: Optional Feishu user id to filter results by owner.

page_size.description: Number of results to return per page.

page_token.description: Pagination token returned by a previous search request.

tool_schemas.name: update_feishu_block_text
tool_schemas.description: Updates the text content of an existing block identified by block_id in the document and returns the updated block (or update result); if idempotency_key is provided, retries with the same key do not apply the change more than once. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR when required fields are missing/invalid (including empty/invalid ids), UNAUTHORIZED/FORBIDDEN when the tenant connection is invalid or lacks edit permission, NOT_FOUND when the document or block does not exist or is not accessible, CONFLICT when the idempotency_key is reused with different parameters, and CONFLICT when the target block type does not support direct text updates (for example, non-textual blocks).

tenant_id.description: Tenant connection id (ULID) used to authenticate Feishu API calls.

document_id.description: Feishu document id/token (doc/docx id) that the block belongs to.

text.description: New plain text content to set on the block.

idempotency_key.description: Optional idempotency key to safely retry the update without duplicating effects.

tool_schemas.name: batch_create_feishu_blocks
tool_schemas.description: Creates multiple blocks under parent_block_id starting at start_index and returns the created block ids in order; large requests may be internally split but preserve the input order as inserted. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR when tenant_id/document_id/parent_block_id are missing, when start_index is negative, when blocks is empty, or when any block spec is invalid (e.g., heading without a valid heading_level or list_item without list_type as required); raises UNAUTHORIZED/FORBIDDEN when the tenant connection is invalid or lacks edit permission; raises NOT_FOUND when the document or parent block does not exist or is not accessible; and raises CONFLICT when insertion is not allowed due to an invalid start_index for the current parent children state or when idempotency_key is reused with different payload parameters.

tenant_id.description: Tenant connection id (ULID) used to authenticate Feishu API calls.

document_id.description: Feishu document id/token (doc/docx id) to create blocks in.

parent_block_id.description: Feishu parent block id under which the new blocks will be inserted (often the root block id).

start_index.description: Zero-based insertion index within the parent block's children where the first new block will be placed.

text.description: Plain text content for text/heading/list_item blocks.

heading_level.description: Heading level (1-9) when block_type is heading.

code_language.description: Programming language identifier when block_type is code.

list_type.description: List style when block_type is list_item.

blocks.description: Ordered list of blocks to create consecutively starting at start_index.

idempotency_key.description: Optional idempotency key to safely retry the batch create without duplicating blocks.

tool_schemas.name: create_feishu_text_block
tool_schemas.description: Creates a new text block with precise style control. Unlike markdown-based formatting, this tool lets you explicitly set text styles for each text segment. Ideal for formatted documents where exact styling control is needed. NOTE: If creating multiple blocks at once, use batch_create_feishu_blocks tool instead for better efficiency. Note: For Feishu wiki links (https://xxx.feishu.cn/wiki/xxx) you must first use convert_feishu_wiki_to_document_id tool to obtain a compatible document ID.

tenant_id.description: Tenant connection id (tenants.id) used to call Feishu APIs.

document_id.description: Target document id (documents.id) to insert the block into.

parent_block_id.description: Feishu parent block id under which to create the new block (typically the document root block id).

insert_position.description: Where to insert relative to the parent or relative to the reference block.

reference_block_id.description: Feishu block id used as the reference when insert_position is before/after.

segments.description: Text segments to compose the block, each with explicit style control.

code_inline.description: Whether this segment is inline code.

link_url.description: Optional URL to apply as a hyperlink for this segment.

idempotency_key.description: Optional idempotency key to deduplicate retries for this mutation (operations.idempotency_key).

tool_schemas.name: create_feishu_code_block
tool_schemas.description: Creates a new code block with syntax highlighting and formatting options. Ideal for technical documentation, tutorials, or displaying code examples with proper formatting and language-specific highlighting. NOTE: If creating multiple blocks at once, use batch_create_feishu_blocks tool instead for better efficiency. Note: For Feishu wiki links (https://xxx.feishu.cn/wiki/xxx) you must first use convert_feishu_wiki_to_document_id tool to obtain a compatible document ID.

tenant_id.description: Tenant connection id (tenants.id) used to call Feishu APIs.

document_id.description: Target document id (documents.id) to insert the block into.

parent_block_id.description: Feishu parent block id under which to create the new block (typically the document root block id).

insert_position.description: Where to insert relative to the parent or relative to the reference block.

reference_block_id.description: Feishu block id used as the reference when insert_position is before/after.

code.description: Full code content for the code block.

language.description: Programming language name used for syntax highlighting.

idempotency_key.description: Optional idempotency key to deduplicate retries for this mutation (operations.idempotency_key).

tool_schemas.name: create_feishu_heading_block
tool_schemas.description: Creates a heading block under the given parent in the specified Feishu document and inserts it at the requested position (start/end, or before/after a reference block), returning the created block (including its Feishu block id) and the recorded operation when available. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if level is not 1–9, insert_position is before/after without reference_block_id, or required fields are missing/invalid; raises NOT_FOUND if the tenant, document, parent block, or reference block does not exist (or is not accessible in the tenant). Raises FORBIDDEN if the tenant connection is not authorized to edit the document, CONFLICT if the document/block state does not allow insertion at the requested location, and RATE_LIMITED if Feishu or integration quotas are exceeded.

tenant_id.description: Tenant connection id (tenants.id) used to call Feishu APIs.

document_id.description: Target document id (documents.id) to insert the block into.

parent_block_id.description: Feishu parent block id under which to create the new block (typically the document root block id).

insert_position.description: Where to insert relative to the parent or relative to the reference block.

reference_block_id.description: Feishu block id used as the reference when insert_position is before/after.

idempotency_key.description: Optional idempotency key to deduplicate retries for this mutation (operations.idempotency_key).

tool_schemas.name: create_feishu_list_block
tool_schemas.description: Creates a single ordered or unordered list-item block with optional indent_level under the given parent in the specified Feishu document and inserts it at the requested position, returning the created block and associated operation metadata when available. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if list_type is not supported, indent_level is negative, insert_position is before/after without reference_block_id, or required fields are missing/invalid; raises NOT_FOUND if the tenant, document, parent block, or reference block cannot be found or accessed. Raises FORBIDDEN when the tenant connection lacks permission to edit the document, CONFLICT when the requested insertion cannot be applied due to document/block state, and RATE_LIMITED when request/tenant quotas are exceeded.

tenant_id.description: Tenant connection id (tenants.id) used to call Feishu APIs.

document_id.description: Target document id (documents.id) to insert the block into.

parent_block_id.description: Feishu parent block id under which to create the new block (typically the document root block id).

insert_position.description: Where to insert relative to the parent or relative to the reference block.

reference_block_id.description: Feishu block id used as the reference when insert_position is before/after.

list_type.description: List kind for the list item.

indent_level.description: Indent nesting level for the list item.

idempotency_key.description: Optional idempotency key to deduplicate retries for this mutation (operations.idempotency_key).

tool_schemas.name: convert_feishu_wiki_to_document_id
tool_schemas.description: Resolves a Feishu Wiki URL to the underlying document identifier that our document endpoints accept, returning the converted document id (and any available resolved metadata). Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if wiki_url is not a valid Feishu wiki link format or required inputs are missing, and NOT_FOUND if the wiki node cannot be resolved in the given tenant. Raises FORBIDDEN if the tenant connection cannot access the wiki resource and RATE_LIMITED if lookup quotas are exceeded.

tenant_id.description: Tenant connection id (tenants.id) used to call Feishu APIs.

tool_schemas.name: delete_feishu_document_blocks
tool_schemas.description: Deletes consecutive blocks from a Feishu document, either by providing start_block_id/end_block_id (inclusive) or an explicit ordered list of block_ids, and returns a deletion result summarizing what was removed and the recorded operation when available. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if neither a valid (start,end) range nor block_ids is provided, if block_ids are not consecutive/in-order, or if identifiers are malformed; raises NOT_FOUND if the tenant, document, or any referenced block does not exist or is not accessible. Raises FORBIDDEN if the tenant connection lacks edit permissions, CONFLICT if the blocks cannot be deleted due to document/block state or non-consecutive range, and RATE_LIMITED when quotas are exceeded.

tenant_id.description: Tenant connection id (tenants.id) used to call Feishu APIs.

document_id.description: Target document id (documents.id) whose blocks will be deleted.

start_block_id.description: Feishu block id of the first block to delete.

end_block_id.description: Feishu block id of the last block to delete (inclusive).

block_ids.description: Explicit list of consecutive Feishu block ids to delete.

idempotency_key.description: Optional idempotency key to deduplicate retries for this mutation (operations.idempotency_key).

tool_schemas.name: get_feishu_image_resource
tool_schemas.description: Downloads the binary image content for a given Feishu media_id within the scope of the specified tenant and returns the image bytes (with content type when available). Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if media_id is missing/invalid and NOT_FOUND if the media_id does not exist or is not available to the tenant. Raises FORBIDDEN if the tenant connection is not authorized to read the media resource and RATE_LIMITED if download quotas are exceeded.

tenant_id.description: Tenant connection id (tenants.id) used to call Feishu APIs.

media_id.description: Feishu media id to download (media_assets.feishu_media_id or block-referenced media id).

tool_schemas.name: create_feishu_image_block
tool_schemas.description: Creates an image block in the specified Feishu document by inserting an empty image block, uploading the image from the provided source (url or local_path), and binding the uploaded media to the new block, returning the created block and media binding details when available. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if source_kind/source_uri are invalid, insert_position is before/after without reference_block_id, or required fields are missing/invalid; raises NOT_FOUND if the tenant, document, parent block, reference block, or fetched source cannot be found. Raises FORBIDDEN if the tenant connection cannot edit the document or upload media, CONFLICT if the block cannot be created/bound due to document or block state, and RATE_LIMITED if mutation/upload quotas are exceeded.

tenant_id.description: Tenant connection id (tenants.id) used to call Feishu APIs.

document_id.description: Target document id (documents.id) to insert the image block into.

parent_block_id.description: Feishu parent block id under which to create the new image block (typically the document root block id).

insert_position.description: Where to insert relative to the parent or relative to the reference block.

reference_block_id.description: Feishu block id used as the reference when insert_position is before/after.

source_kind.description: Where to read the image from.

source_uri.description: HTTP/HTTPS URL or local filesystem path for the image (depending on source_kind).

idempotency_key.description: Optional idempotency key to deduplicate retries for this mutation (operations.idempotency_key).

tool_schemas.name: upload_and_bind_image_to_block
tool_schemas.description: Uploads an image from the provided source (url or local_path) and binds it to an existing image block in the specified document, returning the resulting media asset reference and the updated block binding details. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if the source is invalid/unreadable, required identifiers are missing/invalid, or the target block is not eligible for image binding; raises NOT_FOUND if the tenant, document, or block_id does not exist or is not accessible. Raises FORBIDDEN if the tenant connection lacks permission to edit the document or upload media, CONFLICT if the target block is not an empty image block or cannot transition to a bound state, and RATE_LIMITED if upload/bind quotas are exceeded.

tenant_id.description: Tenant ULID (fs_tnt_01H...) used to authenticate and scope the upload/bind operation.

document_id.description: Document ULID (fs_doc_01H...) that owns the target image block.

block_id.description: Document block ULID (fs_blk_01H...) of an existing empty image block to bind the uploaded image to.

source_kind.description: Where to read the image from (HTTP/HTTPS URL or local filesystem path).

source_uri.description: The image URL (if source_kind=url) or local file path (if source_kind=local_path).

content_type.description: Optional MIME type for the image (e.g., image/png, image/jpeg).

idempotency_key.description: Optional idempotency key to safely retry the upload/bind without duplicating media.

tool_schemas.name: get_feishu_root_folder_info
tool_schemas.description: Retrieves basic information about the root folder in Feishu Drive. Returns the token, ID and user ID of the root folder, which can be used for subsequent folder operations.

tenant_id.description: Tenant ULID (fs_tnt_01H...) used to look up the Feishu Drive root for that tenant connection.

user_id.description: Optional Feishu user ID to query the root folder for; defaults to the tenant's default_user_id.

refresh.description: Whether to force a fresh lookup from Feishu instead of using cached drive_items data.

tool_schemas.name: get_feishu_folder_files
tool_schemas.description: Retrieves a list of files and subfolders in a specified folder. Use this to explore folder contents, view file metadata, and get URLs and tokens for further operations.

tenant_id.description: Tenant ULID (fs_tnt_01H...) used to authenticate and scope the folder listing.

folder_token.description: Feishu Drive folder token to list contents for.

page_size.description: Number of items to return per page.

page_token.description: Cursor token for pagination returned by the previous call.

include_deleted.description: Whether to include deleted/inaccessible items when available.

tool_schemas.name: create_feishu_folder
tool_schemas.description: Creates a new folder in a specified parent folder. Use this to organize documents and files within your Feishu Drive structure. Returns the token and URL of the newly created folder.

tenant_id.description: Tenant ULID (fs_tnt_01H...) used to authenticate and scope the folder creation.

parent_folder_token.description: Feishu Drive folder token under which the new folder will be created.

idempotency_key.description: Optional idempotency key to safely retry folder creation without creating duplicates.

tool_schemas.name: create_feishu_tenant_connection
tool_schemas.description: Creates a new tenant connection used to authenticate all subsequent Feishu API calls, storing the provided app credentials (ciphertext) and initial scope configuration. Returns the created tenant connection record. Refuses INVALID_CREDENTIALS/UNAUTHORIZED if the credentials cannot be validated (when validate=true), and VALIDATION_ERROR when required fields are missing or malformed.

feishu_tenant_key.description: Feishu tenant key (租户 key) for the tenant being connected.

app_id.description: Feishu app_id used to obtain tenant access tokens.

app_secret_ciphertext.description: Encrypted/ciphertext representation of the Feishu app_secret to store server-side.

default_user_id.description: Optional default Feishu user id to use for actions that require a user context when the API supports it.

scopes.description: Requested/expected Feishu scopes for this integration; stored for diagnostics and entitlement checks.

validate.description: When true, verifies the credentials against Feishu before persisting the connection; failures are rejected and no connection is created.

idempotency_key.description: Optional idempotency key to safely retry connection creation without duplicates.

tool_schemas.name: list_feishu_tenants
tool_schemas.description: Lists stored Feishu tenant connections visible to the caller, with optional filtering by status and tenant_key. Returns a paginated list ordered by created_at descending. Refuses UNAUTHORIZED when the caller cannot access tenant connections.

status.description: Optional filter by tenant connection status.

feishu_tenant_key.description: Optional exact-match filter by Feishu tenant key.

page_size.description: Number of tenant connections to return per page.

page_token.description: Pagination token returned by a previous list call.

tool_schemas.name: update_feishu_tenant_status
tool_schemas.description: Transitions a tenant connection lifecycle state (active/error/revoked). Returns the updated tenant record. Refuses INVALID_TRANSITION when the requested status is not allowed from the current state, and FORBIDDEN when the caller is not entitled to manage the tenant connection.

tenant_id.description: Tenant connection id (ULID) to update.

status.description: Target tenant connection status. Allowed transitions: active→(error,revoked), error→(active,revoked).

last_error_code.description: Optional error code to store when setting status=error.

last_error_message.description: Optional human-readable error message to store when setting status=error.

tool_schemas.name: list_feishu_drive_items
tool_schemas.description: Lists cached Feishu Drive items for a tenant (folders, docs, wiki nodes) with filtering by parent, type, status, and a simple title query. Returns a paginated list. Refuses UNAUTHORIZED/FORBIDDEN if the tenant connection is not accessible.

tenant_id.description: Tenant connection id (ULID) whose Drive cache to query.

parent_item_id.description: Optional filter by parent drive_items.id (server id). Use null/omit to list across all parents.

item_type.description: Optional filter by Drive item type.

status.description: Optional filter by cached Drive item status.

query.description: Optional case-insensitive substring match against title for quick search.

page_size.description: Number of items to return per page.

page_token.description: Pagination token returned by a previous list call.

tool_schemas.implementation:
def list_feishu_drive_items(tenant_id, parent_item_id=None, item_type=None, status=None, query=None, page_size=None, page_token=None, **_extra):
    import json, os, datetime, time, re, base64
    _DB = __import__("os").environ.get("MCP_DB_DIR") or ("./environment_mix/0283000" if __import__("os").path.isdir("./environment_mix/0283000") else "/app/database")
    def _load(n):
        try:
            with open(os.path.join(_DB, n), encoding="utf-8") as f: return json.load(f)
        except Exception: return []
    def _save(n, d):
        with open(os.path.join(_DB, n), "w", encoding="utf-8") as f: json.dump(d, f, ensure_ascii=False, indent=2)
    def _err(code, msg, **x): return {"error": {"code": code, "message": msg, **x}}

    t0 = time.time()
    now = datetime.datetime.utcnow().replace(microsecond=0).isoformat() + "Z"

    if not isinstance(tenant_id, str) or not re.match(r"^fs_tnt_[0-9A-HJKMNP-TV-Z]{10,}$", tenant_id):
        return _err("VALIDATION_ERROR", "tenant_id is invalid")
    if parent_item_id is not None and (not isinstance(parent_item_id, str) or not parent_item_id.strip()):
        return _err("VALIDATION_ERROR", "parent_item_id must be a non-empty string when provided")
    if item_type is not None:
        if not isinstance(item_type, str):
            return _err("VALIDATION_ERROR", "item_type must be a string when provided")
        # tool enum includes docx and unknown; drive_items schema uses doc and unknown. Accept docx by mapping to doc.
        if item_type not in ("folder", "doc", "docx", "sheet", "bitable", "mindnote", "wiki_node", "file", "unknown", "slide"):
            return _err("VALIDATION_ERROR", "item_type is invalid")
    if status is not None:
        if not isinstance(status, str) or status not in ("active", "deleted", "inaccessible", "unknown"):
            return _err("VALIDATION_ERROR", "status must be one of: active, deleted, inaccessible, unknown")
    if query is not None and (not isinstance(query, str) or not query.strip()):
        return _err("VALIDATION_ERROR", "query must be a non-empty string when provided")
    if page_size is None:
        page_size = 50
    if not isinstance(page_size, int) or page_size < 1 or page_size > 200:
        return _err("VALIDATION_ERROR", "page_size must be an integer between 1 and 200")
    if page_token is not None and (not isinstance(page_token, str) or not page_token.strip()):
        return _err("VALIDATION_ERROR", "page_token must be a non-empty string when provided")

    tenants = _load("tenants.json")
    drive_items = _load("drive_items.json")
    operations = _load("operations.json")

    # Resolve tenant + auth prerequisite: tenant connection must exist; for drive cache listing, allow any status except revoked?
    tenant = None
    for t in tenants:
        if t.get("id") == tenant_id:
            tenant = t
            break
    if tenant is None:
        # log operation as failed
        def _ulid(prefix):
            alphabet = "0123456789ABCDEFGHJKMNPQRSTVWXYZ"
            ms = int(time.time() * 1000)
            ts = ms
            chars = []
            for _ in range(10):
                chars.append(alphabet[ts % 32])
                ts //= 32
            ts_part = "".join(reversed(chars))
            rnd = os.urandom(10)
            v = int.from_bytes(rnd, "big")
            rchars = []
            for _ in range(16):
                rchars.append(alphabet[v % 32])
                v //= 32
            return f"{prefix}_{ts_part}{''.join(reversed(rchars))}"
        op_id = _ulid("fs_op")
        operations.append({
            "id": op_id,
            "tenant_id": tenant_id,
            "tool_name": "list_feishu_drive_items",
            "request_json": {
                "tenant_id": tenant_id,
                "parent_item_id": parent_item_id,
                "item_type": item_type,
                "status": status,
                "query": query,
                "page_size": page_size,
                "page_token": page_token
            },
            "target_drive_item_id": None,
            "target_document_id": None,
            "target_block_id": None,
            "status": "failed",
            "idempotency_key": None,
            "feishu_request_id": None,
            "response_json": None,
            "error_code": "NOT_FOUND",
            "error_message": "tenant not found",
            "duration_ms": int((time.time() - t0) * 1000),
            "created_at": now,
            "updated_at": now
        })
        _save("operations.json", operations)
        return _err("NOT_FOUND", "Tenant not found")

    if tenant.get("status") == "revoked":
        # log and refuse
        def _ulid(prefix):
            alphabet = "0123456789ABCDEFGHJKMNPQRSTVWXYZ"
            ms = int(time.time() * 1000)
            ts = ms
            chars = []
            for _ in range(10):
                chars.append(alphabet[ts % 32])
                ts //= 32
            ts_part = "".join(reversed(chars))
            rnd = os.urandom(10)
            v = int.from_bytes(rnd, "big")
            rchars = []
            for _ in range(16):
                rchars.append(alphabet[v % 32])
                v //= 32
            return f"{prefix}_{ts_part}{''.join(reversed(rchars))}"
        op_id = _ulid("fs_op")
        operations.append({
            "id": op_id,
            "tenant_id": tenant_id,
            "tool_name": "list_feishu_drive_items",
            "request_json": {
                "tenant_id": tenant_id,
                "parent_item_id": parent_item_id,
                "item_type": item_type,
                "status": status,
                "query": query,
                "page_size": page_size,
                "page_token": page_token
            },
            "target_drive_item_id": None,
            "target_document_id": None,
            "target_block_id": None,
            "status": "failed",
            "idempotency_key": None,
            "feishu_request_id": None,
            "response_json": None,
            "error_code": "UNAUTHORIZED",
            "error_message": "tenant connection is revoked",
            "duration_ms": int((time.time() - t0) * 1000),
            "created_at": now,
            "updated_at": now
        })
        _save("operations.json", operations)
        return _err("UNAUTHORIZED", "Tenant connection is revoked")

    # log op first (running)
    def _ulid(prefix):
        alphabet = "0123456789ABCDEFGHJKMNPQRSTVWXYZ"
        ms = int(time.time() * 1000)
        ts = ms
        chars = []
        for _ in range(10):
            chars.append(alphabet[ts % 32])
            ts //= 32
        ts_part = "".join(reversed(chars))
        rnd = os.urandom(10)
        v = int.from_bytes(rnd, "big")
        rchars = []
        for _ in range(16):
            rchars.append(alphabet[v % 32])
            v //= 32
        return f"{prefix}_{ts_part}{''.join(reversed(rchars))}"
    op_id = _ulid("fs_op")
    operations.append({
        "id": op_id,
        "tenant_id": tenant_id,
        "tool_name": "list_feishu_drive_items",
        "request_json": {
            "tenant_id": tenant_id,
            "parent_item_id": parent_item_id,
            "item_type": item_type,
            "status": status,
            "query": query,
            "page_size": page_size,
            "page_token": page_token
        },
        "target_drive_item_id": None,
        "target_document_id": None,
        "target_block_id": None,
        "status": "running",
        "idempotency_key": None,
        "feishu_request_id": None,
        "response_json": None,
        "error_code": None,
        "error_message": None,
        "duration_ms": None,
        "created_at": now,
        "updated_at": now
    })
    _save("operations.json", operations)

    # Decode page_token as offset
    offset = 0
    if page_token:
        try:
            raw = base64.urlsafe_b64decode(page_token.encode("utf-8") + b"===")
            offset = int(raw.decode("utf-8"))
            if offset < 0:
                raise ValueError("negative")
        except Exception:
            for oop in operations:
                if oop.get("id") == op_id:
                    oop["status"] = "failed"
                    oop["error_code"] = "VALIDATION_ERROR"
                    oop["error_message"] = "page_token is invalid"
                    oop["duration_ms"] = int((time.time() - t0) * 1000)
                    oop["updated_at"] = now
                    break
            _save("operations.json", operations)
            return _err("VALIDATION_ERROR", "page_token is invalid")

    rows = [di for di in drive_items if di.get("tenant_id") == tenant_id]

    if parent_item_id is not None:
        rows = [di for di in rows if di.get("parent_item_id") == parent_item_id]
    if item_type is not None:
        mapped = "doc" if item_type == "docx" else item_type
        # Note: drive_items.item_type enum doesn't include docx or unknown? it includes unknown, not docx. docx mapped above.
        rows = [di for di in rows if di.get("item_type") == mapped]
    if status is not None:
        rows = [di for di in rows if di.get("status") == status]
    if query is not None:
        q = query.casefold()
        def _title(di):
            v = di.get("title")
            return v if isinstance(v, str) else ""
        rows = [di for di in rows if q in _title(di).casefold()]

    # Order: last_seen_at desc, then created_at desc for stability
    def _key(di):
        return (di.get("last_seen_at") or "", di.get("created_at") or "", di.get("id") or "")
    rows.sort(key=_key, reverse=True)

    total = len(rows)
    page = rows[offset:offset + page_size]
    next_offset = offset + len(page)
    has_more = next_offset < total
    next_token = None
    if has_more:
        next_token = base64.urlsafe_b64encode(str(next_offset).encode("utf-8")).decode("utf-8").rstrip("=")

    resp = {
        "items": page,
        "total": total,
        "has_more": has_more,
        "next_page_token": next_token
    }

    for oop in operations:
        if oop.get("id") == op_id:
            oop["status"] = "succeeded"
            oop["response_json"] = {"count": len(page), "total": total, "has_more": has_more}
            oop["duration_ms"] = int((time.time() - t0) * 1000)
            oop["updated_at"] = now
            break
    _save("operations.json", operations)

    return resp

tool_schemas.name: batch_update_feishu_blocks
tool_schemas.description: Applies multiple block mutations to a document in one request, splitting into multiple upstream Feishu calls when needed (max 50 operations per upstream request) while creating an operations row per upstream call and linking them via the idempotency_key prefix. Returns a combined result including per-operation outcomes and the final snapshot_version. Refuses VALIDATION_ERROR for invalid payloads, FORBIDDEN when the tenant lacks write permission, and RATE_LIMITED when the server predicts tenant rate limits would be exceeded.

tenant_id.description: Tenant connection id (ULID) used to authenticate Feishu API calls.

idempotency_key.description: Idempotency key used to deduplicate retries; when auto-splitting, the server will suffix this key per upstream call.

parent_block_id.description: Required for create: Feishu parent block id under which to insert new blocks.

index.description: Optional insertion index under the parent for create; when omitted, appends.

block_type.description: Required for create: block type to create.

text.description: Text payload for create/update_text. For update_text, the target block must be one of: text/heading/code/list_item.

heading_level.description: Optional heading level for heading blocks (create).

code_language.description: Optional language identifier for code blocks (create).

list_type.description: Optional list type for list_item blocks (create).

block_id.description: Required for update_text/delete: Feishu block id to mutate.

delete_count.description: Optional for delete: number of consecutive blocks to delete starting at block_id; server validates consecutiveness under the same parent.

replace_media.description: Optional for image blocks: when true, allows replacing an existing bound image.

media_asset_id.description: Optional for image block create/update: media_assets.id to bind (must be uploaded) if binding is desired as part of the batch.

operations.description: Array of block mutations to apply. The server enforces Feishu constraints and may refetch blocks for safe deletes.

metadata.name: Feishu(飞书) Integration Server
metadata.description: This backend stores Feishu tenant connections, Drive items (folders/documents), document block snapshots/operations, and media assets (images) handled by the integration server. Main workflows: connect to a tenant, browse/search Drive, read document metadata/content/blocks, mutate documents by creat
